---
title: "ES 661: Probabilistic machine learning"
subtitle: "August 2023 · IIT Gandhinagar"
---

::: {.lead}
Machine learning with uncertainty. The course starts from Bayes' rule for the parameters of a model, moves from
maximum likelihood and MAP estimates to full posteriors, and then approximates the posteriors that have no closed
form with the Laplace approximation, sampling, MCMC and variational inference. It ends with uses of uncertainty in
neural networks, meta-learning, active learning and Bayesian optimisation. Every lecture's slides, notebooks, cheat
sheet and recording are in the [lecture library](schedule.qmd), where three-minute summary videos are being added.
:::

## Main topics

1. Bayesian inference
2. Estimation: maximum likelihood, maximum a posteriori, full Bayesian
3. Sampling: rejection sampling, Monte Carlo, specific sampling techniques (like Box-Muller)
4. Approximate inference: variational inference, Markov chain Monte Carlo, Laplace approximation
5. Models: Bayesian linear and logistic regression; Bayesian neural networks; Gaussian processes; probabilistic PCA
6. Applications: Bayesian optimisation, active learning
